# hush_agent_authorization_server (Data Source)

The authorization server a deployment's service agents sign in at, as its OAuth metadata reports it. Not the gateway's own one, which MCP clients use for users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_agent_authorization_server" "gateway" {
  deployment_id = hush_deployment.gateway.id
}

# The Audience an agent passes to sts:GetWebIdentityToken
output "agent_token_audience" {
  value = data.hush_agent_authorization_server.gateway.issuer
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment whose agent authorization server to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer, which is also the audience ('aud') a service agent's workload token must carry, e.g. the 'Audience' of sts:GetWebIdentityToken or of a projected Kubernetes service account token. Not the deployment's 'oidc_provider' audience.
- `token_endpoint` (String) Where a service agent exchanges its workload token.
